selected.command: npm ls react react-dom @schedule-x/react @schedule-x/calendar @schedule-x/calendar-controls @schedule-x/events-service @schedule-x/theme-default temporal-polyfill preact @preact/signals @radix-ui/react-accordion

sourceObservations.classification: Installed-source observations only; verify behavior in the browser separately.

responsive.finding: Uses calendarWrapper.clientWidth against a root-font-relative 43.75rem threshold (700px at 16px root). Runs once when mounted and on window.resize only; no container ResizeObserver drives this check. A callbacks.isCalendarSmall hook overrides the size predicate.

viewPicker.finding: Picker filters by hasSmallScreenCompat when isCalendarSmall, otherwise by hasWideScreenCompat. isResponsive:false disables the responsive observer, not this picker filtering. Month-grid is wide-only; month-agenda is small-only; Day supports both; Week is wide-only.

plusEvents.finding: Default nEventsPerDay is 4. More control calls callbacks.onClickPlusEvents(date,event) when supplied and returns immediately; otherwise it switches to configured Day view after 250ms. Without a configured Day view it does nothing. monthGridOptions.nEventsPerDay controls the number initially rendered.

multiDayEnd.finding: All-day end is inclusive in month-grid (<= lastDateOfEvent) and month-agenda (getAllEventDates includes end). A Monday–Friday span ends on Friday, not Saturday.
